title: Remove a product from the cart on the Cart page
steps: Add a product to the cart.
Select the Remove action for the cart item.
Observe the cart immediately after removal.
expected_result: The selected product is removed from the cart, the cart badge count updates, and the cart contents are refreshed without leaving stale entries behind.

title: Remove a product from the Inventory page
steps: Log in and navigate to the Inventory page.
Add a product to the cart.
Use the Remove action on the product card or cart entry from the Inventory view.
Navigate to the cart and confirm the product is no longer listed.
expected_result: The product is removed from the cart from the Inventory page and the cart badge, cart contents, and actions reflect the new state immediately.

title: Remove one of multiple cart entries without affecting the others
steps: Log in and add two products to the cart.
Remove one product while leaving the other in the cart.
Inspect the remaining product and the product count.
expected_result: Only the selected product is removed; the remaining item stays in the cart and the badge count reflects the correct reduced total.
